column1: # RAWmakase's black & white chart (MIT), as text, for B&W's mix (rm_black_white.rs).
# Generated by scripts/rawmakase-gray-chart.mjs: never edit a row by hand.
# Camera Raw 18.7's own renders of a colour chart, measured by RAWmakase
# (its docs/color-mixer.md, "Chart gray"). Each table covers the colour
# mixer's grid of linear ProPhoto RGB: 36 hues, 6 saturations, 6 values. A
# cell is log2 of the grey's luminance over the colour's, in steps of 1/4000:
# the "zero" table at a zero mix, then each band's change at -100, -50, +50
# and +100. A row is one table and one hue: its name, the hue (0-35), then the
# hue's 36 cells, saturation outer and value inner.
